retention.description: Retention policy for Cloudflare R2 active releases
retention.policyNotes: When Google Drive is disabled, releases exceeding maxStableReleasesPerPlatform or size caps are labeled 'eligible_for_archival' and REMAIN in R2 with zero deletions.

googleDrive.serviceAccountQuotasNotice: Google Drive Service Accounts do not have independent default drive storage. The target folder MUST be created in a user/workspace Drive and shared with the Service Account email as 'Editor'.
